title: Superseded: Turso-like libSQL database testing harness support to Vaporize
createdBy: codex after operator requested Turso-like testing harness setup in the Vaporize modernization workstream

historicalContent.sourceLocation: Codex session 2026-06-26: operator said the workstream specifically needs to start moving to a Turso-like testing harness setup.
historicalContent.description: Vaporize needs a database test harness that can model the local/remote split expected from Turso/libSQL without making default tests depend on external network state. The first implementation slice adds shared test-support models and CUJ21 coverage for local libSQL-style fixture materialization, remote Turso-style configuration capture, and JSON receipt round-tripping.

supersededBy.reason: Operator correction on 2026-06-26: the core abstraction is not a database harness. Vaporize needs CUJ state for spawn and modification proof; Kura/database concerns are subordinate implementation context.

implementedFirstSlice.vaporizeReceipt: vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh test --package-path private/universal/substrate/collectives/wrkstrm-core/private/apple/spm/vaporize@wrkstrm-core.cli --configuration debug -- --filter VaporizeCUJ21DatabaseHarnessTests passed 3 tests

acceptanceCriteria: This superseded bead remains only as a historical correction record.
The active implementation and proof move to the CUJ-state replacement bead.
No board packet should treat this database/Turso framing as the approved abstraction.
knownSeparations: This slice is a deterministic test harness scaffold, not a production Turso client.
Default tests remain network-free; real Turso integration must be explicit and environment gated.
The observed CUJ08 Concourse project.yml fixture mismatch is a stale live-fixture expectation, not a database harness regression.
